items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: Billy, let me just play that.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. There was one job, one, who knows, and in the little Spanish time, remember that? Yeah. And the second one player couldn't get off on it. Billy, let me just play that. Boy, I'm the second one, I played the hell out of it, man. The second one wasn't a mile ahead before.
